text:
customer-ops: Heads-up — ACME reporting intermittent 502/504s from hosted API for streaming endpoints after their SSO cert rotation. ~30% of streaming requests fail within 10–20s. Non-streaming calls seem fine. sample trace ids: trace-9f3b, trace-9f3c. Ticket: https://support.redwood/acme/1234 :eyes:

morgan: Thanks — can you paste a minimal repro and the exact error from the gateway? Any recent deploys/edge config changes on our side?@devon fyi

customer-ops: Repro (from their env):
```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":512}'
```
Errors they see: "502 Bad Gateway" then connection reset; sometimes 504 after long pause. Upstream envoy logs show: `envoy reset stream: CANCELLED` and `upstream connection closed` around same time. No auth failures in our logs.

devon: Ok — initial thought: long-lived h2 streams + upstream keepalive/connpool exhaustion after their cert rotation/short TTLs. Could be idle window/GOAWAY behavior. Do we have ingress-nginx/edge-proxy restarts around that time? Can you grab edge-proxy stderr + envoy access logs for traces above? Also share LB (frontdoor) 502/504 counters.

anika: I checked model infra metrics for the window — GPUs and runtime are healthy, request latencies normal. There's a small bump in connections accepted on edge proxies at the same time as ACME rotation (maybe their clients retried aggressively).

morgan: If retries + h2 keepalive exhaustion, a quick mitigation is to force short-lived connections from frontdoor to edge for that tenant (disable HTTP/2 passthrough) or reduce max concurrent streams per connection. Can we patch a per-tenant route to `proxy_http_version 1.1` or set `stream_max_requests` lower?

devon: I can do a targeted change on the frontend LB route for ACME — switching to http/1.1 upstream for streaming should avoid h2 stream multiplexing pressure. I'll roll a config change to the route and watch.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update: frontdoor-route-acme (1/3) -> updating upstream protocol to http/1.1

customer-ops: Applied on their route — customer confirmed reduced error rate within 90s. They see sustained streaming success now.

morgan: Good quick mitigation. Next steps: collect envoy+nginx logs for the original time window, capture connection-level stats (active streams per conn, GOAWAY events), and add a per-tenant circuit-breaker to guard against retry storms.

anika: I'll open an infra ticket to add passive metrics and an alert for h2 stream saturation + increased GOAWAYs. Also recommend we evaluate changing default max concurrent streams and keepalive timeouts.

devon: Filed: INFRA-7891 with initial notes and correlating traces (attached). Moving to postmortem if we find systemic config gaps.

customer-ops: ACME wants a short blurb for the incident summary and the temporary workaround we applied. I'll prepare and send. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

morgan: thanks — capture the mitigation steps and timeline in the ticket. We'll follow up with a config rollout if tests confirm.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update: frontdoor-route-acme (3/3) -> complete
